- Inflicting the target with <color=Highlight><te href=850008>Spectro Frazzle</te></color>, <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color>, <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color>, <color=Highlight><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color>, and <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color>, or deal the corresponding Negative Status DMG.
- Consuming <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color> stacks on the target by landing a skill.
When the active Resonator is not in the <color=Highlight>Ceaseless Landscape</color>, this Crit. DMG bonus effect is disabled.

3.name: Sparse Curtains Invite Evening Glow
3.desc:
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Drizzle Stance</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance Stage 4</color>.
<size=10></size>

Casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance Stage 4</color> consumes <color=Highlight>Kingfisher</color> to restore {0} points of Concerto Energy and {1} points of <color=Highlight><te href=111008>Floral Epistle</te></color>. <color=Highlight>Kingfisher</color> can be consumed up to once every {2}s.

81001110.name: Suisui
81001110.bg_description: Suisui's go-to trading attire. A qipao tailored in striking gold and jade. With every step, its feather-like sleeves sway gracefully like shimmering ripples. In this dress, she has traversed rivers and mountains, charting the endless splendor of the peaceful world.

features: Fight in two stances: <color=Highlight>Water Fan Dance</color> and <color=Highlight>Water Sleeves Dance</color>.
Casting Resonance Liberation grants the team bonus effects related to <color=Highlight>Negative Status</color>.
Outro Skill grants <color=Highlight>All DMG Amplification</color> to all Resonators in the team.

111001.desc: When in <color=Highlight>Zephyr Stance</color>, Suisui can obtain <color=Highlight>Cloud Breath</color> through certain attacks. When at full <color=Highlight>Cloud Breath</color>, cast <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill- Awakening Spring</color> to enter <color=Highlight>Drizzle Stance</color>.

111002.desc: When in  <color=Highlight>Drizzle Stance</color>, Suisui can obtain <color=Highlight>Floral Epistle</color> through certain attacks. The amount of bonus effects granted by <color=Highlight>Outro Skill</color> is proportional to the amount of <color=Highlight>Floral Epistle</color> consumed while casting <color=Highlight>Outro Skill - Rippling Waters</color>.

111003.desc: Resonance Skill - Awakening Spring: When in <color=Highlight>Zephyr Stance</color> and at full <color=Highlight>Cloud Breath</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} {0} to cast this skill. Casting this skill consumes all <color=Highlight>Cloud Breath</color> and sends Suisui into <color=Highlight>Drizzle Stance</color>, continuously healing nearby Resonators in the team.

111004.desc: Outro Skill - Rippling Waters: Casting this skill consumes all <color=Highlight>Floral Epistle</color>. If <color=Highlight>Ceaseless Landscape</color> is active, Suisui instead enters <color=Highlight>Roaming Transcendent</color> and unlocks bonus effects based on the amount of <color=Highlight>Floral Epistle</color> consumed. Every 200 points unlocks a new set of effects.
